# Precepts

> Multi-discipline standards platform. Built for humans. Ready for agents.

Standards are published as machine-readable Markdown with YAML frontmatter, consumable by both humans and AI agents.

## Disciplines

- [Integration Standards](/docs/integration/): API design, events, resilience, observability, data formats
- [Product Management](/docs/product/): Requirements, roadmapping, prioritization
- [UX Standards](/docs/ux/): Accessibility, design systems, interaction patterns
- [Project Management](/docs/project-management/): Ceremonies, estimation, delivery

## Integration Standards (Batch 1)

- [INTG-STD-004 Naming Conventions](/docs/integration/standards/foundational/naming-conventions)
- [INTG-STD-005 Character Encoding](/docs/integration/standards/data-formats/character-encoding)
- [INTG-STD-006 Compatibility](/docs/integration/standards/versioning/backward-forward-compatibility)
- [INTG-STD-008 API Resource Design](/docs/integration/standards/api/resource-design)
- [INTG-STD-009 Error Handling](/docs/integration/standards/api/error-handling)
- [INTG-STD-015 Event Envelope](/docs/integration/standards/events/event-envelope)
- [INTG-STD-029 Observability](/docs/integration/standards/observability/integration-observability)
- [INTG-STD-033 Resilience Patterns](/docs/integration/standards/resilience/integration-resilience-patterns)
- [INTG-STD-034 Retry Policy](/docs/integration/standards/resilience/retry-policy)
- [INTG-STD-035 Timeout](/docs/integration/standards/resilience/timeout)

## AI Distribution

Standards are delivered to AI agents via:
1. This llms.txt file (AI crawler index)
2. MCP Server (active querying via Model Context Protocol)
3. CLAUDE.md (auto-loaded by Claude Code)
